name: Graduate Mixed Media Art Book, Hardcover, 5.5 x 8.5 in
bestUse: Best for a first collage book
descriptionOriginal: A small hardcover art book of heavy mixed media paper, in a handbag-friendly 5.5 x 8.5 inch size.
whyWeLikeIt: Heavy 200 g/m2 mixed media paper and a hard cover hold up to layered paper and adhesive better than a thin notebook, in a size that is easy to finish.
limitations: The pages are white, so a sparse spread looks plain until you add paper, and with 36 sheets a keen collager will fill it quickly.
